hero.title: Eat, drink, *gelato*
hero.lede: Breakfast, lunch, specialty coffee and gelato near Woodside in Aiken, made with ingredients from local farms and businesses like Ramey Farms, Hickory Hill Dairy and Grice’s Butcher Shop. Sunday brunch, 10 to 2.

sections.title: The best flavors come from *the best ingredients*

image.alt: Trays of house-made gelato in the case, including coffee Oreo and vanilla crisp

body: We source from local farmers, nurseries and businesses to bring you the best Aiken has to offer, from classic breakfast plates to fresh salads, sandwiches and seasonal specials.

Our gelato is churned slowly from fresh ingredients: about 20 to 30 percent less air than ice cream, more milk than cream, and served a little warmer, so it’s dense, silky and full of flavor. No brain freeze.

sections.title: A room *for your group*
sections.intro: Our private meeting room fits up to 24 people comfortably, for holiday parties, showers and corporate lunches. Order from the menu or ask about on-site catering.
